payload.title: In a repository that does not ignore __pycache__, a seat that ran its red test leaves .pyc files as untracked files and lift_sandbox_pin refuses the whole pin by name; it fails closed, and aqua-saas ignores __pycache__, so only other repositories the bench is pointed at are affected
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:605 (ls-files --others --exclude-standard: only the repository's own ignore rules hide the seat's run by-products)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/validation.py:613-616 (every listed path goes through the pin's path admission, and one non-test path refuses the whole pin)
payload.rule_violated: D6 design: the seat writes and runs its red test in its sandbox and the kernel lifts it; the lift must take the seat's tests, not refuse the by-products of the run the design asks for
payload.notes: Registered by the D6 findings clerk from the D6 review round 1 (lens ssot), re-checked at head ac106b734 before registration; non-blocking at merge. Close condition: One decision, recorded and tested: the seat's sandbox runs with bytecode writing off, or the lift's untracked listing excludes what the validation runner's own tools write, or the refusal stands and the repositories the bench may point at are limited to ones that ignore it. Test: a seat that ran its test in a repository with no ignore rule still has its test lifted, or the chosen refusal is named.
